title: Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Wheelchairs
summary: SUPSI and IDSIA developed a laboratory demonstrator for autonomous wheelchair safety. Independent mobility benefits remain prospective.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: SUPSI and IDSIA developed a laboratory demonstrator for autonomous wheelchair safety. Independent mobility benefits remain prospective. Laboratory demonstrator.
purpose: Support safe door-to-door mobility for people with movement or sensory impairments.
developer: SUPSI / IDSIA Trustworthy Autonomous Systems research group

ratings.reason: People with mobility or sensory impairments are intended to gain safe, independent travel; no real user outcome is documented.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 10: Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence for Autonomous Wheelchairs

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Redundant sensors and run-time danger estimation

headline: Safer autonomous wheelchair navigation in development

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
